messages.text: Hello Jitin, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
I'd love to have, your I think I I I can go ahead with the, big breakfast burrito.

The Big Breakfast Burrito, excellent choice. That's one of our hearty options with bacon, sausage, eggs, salsa, jalapeño cream cheese, and cheddar, plus a hash brown all wrapped up. Let me get all the customization options for you.
Let's start with the Wrap Choice for your Big Breakfast Burrito. You can choose either Flour or Wheat. Which one would you like?

For the Condiments, you have a variety of options to choose from, including Salt, Pepper, Ketchup, Mayo, Mustard, Hot Sauce, Tomato Spread, Butter, Cream Cheese, Flavor CC, and Jelly. You can choose up to 10 condiments. Which ones would you like to add to your Big Breakfast Burrito?
You can, think of mustard only.

I've added Mustard to your Big Breakfast Burrito. Next, let's move on to the Add Vegetables group. You can choose up to 11 options from Lettuce, Tomato, Red Onions, Avocado, Spinach, Cucumber, Green Peppers, Capers, Roasted Red Peppers, Grilled Onions, and Jalapeño Peppers. Which vegetables would you like to add?
I've added Jalapeño Peppers to your Big Breakfast Burrito. Next, let's consider the Egg Type. You have options for Egg White, Scrambled, or No Egg. Which one would you prefer?
I think that's it. I I think that's it for for the, for the this item. You can you can fill the order.
Alright, let me get this order placed for you...
